title: Pre-LN Transformer Block Forward
hints: Write three helpers first: layer_norm(x, g, b), causal multi-head attention, and the tanh-approximate GELU.
Pre-LN means the residual adds the sublayer's output to the un-normalized input: x = x + attn(ln1(x)), not ln1(x) + attn(ln1(x)).
LayerNorm normalizes over the last axis with the biased variance (divide by d) and eps inside the square root.
The causal mask applies inside every head. Query t sees keys 0..t.
